lines.speaker: Tooth-Missing Fan
lines.text: This is just like a game.

lines.speaker: Tooth-Missing Fan
lines.text: Now that there's a food shortage in the shelter,

lines.speaker: Tooth-Missing Fan
lines.text: people have become like rabid dogs, turning against each other.

lines.speaker: Tooth-Missing Fan
lines.text: Suddenly, the heroine rides into town, brings order to the townsfolk,

lines.speaker: Tooth-Missing Fan
lines.text: then rides off into the sunset once her job is done!

lines.speaker: Early Adopter
lines.text: Will you grow up? How can that ever happen?

lines.speaker: Early Adopter
lines.text: Pfft, this ain't some cheap novel.
